text:
If you're heading out this evening, keep an eye on the sky, there's still a shot of a shower or rumble of thunder before 10, but it should wind down after that, leaving a muggy, mostly cloudy night with the low only dipping to around 71. The lake's calming down too, winds easing to light and variable overnight after that gusty southwest breeze this afternoon.

Tomorrow's the pick of this stretch: mostly sunny and warm with a high near 88, though the heat index will make it feel more like the mid-90s, so plan your shade and water accordingly. Air quality creeps to moderate up north as a heads up for anyone sensitive to smoke or ozone. Enjoy the sunshine while it lasts, because showers and thunderstorms return after midnight into Friday night, some capable of heavy rain, and that wetter, stormier pattern sticks around into the weekend. I'd get outdoor plans done by early evening Friday and keep the rain jacket handy for Saturday.

week.blurb: Storms flare up before 10pm tonight, then clouds settle in with lows around 71 and lingering shower risk.

Soggy Saturday with showers and thunderstorms most of the day, a high near 84 and a half inch of rain possible.
Cooler, drier air moves in behind the front, so Sunday turns mostly sunny with a high near 85.
Mostly sunny and pleasant with a high near 84, though afternoon storms are a coin flip again.
A cold front brings likely showers and storms through midday, cooling things to a high near 82.
Refreshing air settles in behind the front, keeping Wednesday partly sunny with a high near 81 and just a slim shower chance.
Trending toward another round of afternoon storms, with partly sunny skies and a high near 81.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST: The Bermuda high weakens and sinks southward Sunday into early next week, allowing a cooler Canadian air to bring a cooling trend and lower humidity. Sunday will feature mostly sunny skies with highs near 85° and only an isolated shower risk over the Northeast Kingdom. Highs remain in the mid-80s Monday with partly sunny skies and an isolated afternoon storm chance (50% chance). A cold front sweeps through late Monday night into Tuesday morning, bringing widespread showers and thunderstorms with a 60% chance of rain. Drier, cooler, and refreshing air builds behind the front for Wednesday and Thursday, with highs dropping into the upper 70s to around 80°.
